children.text: Why is a map better than two nested loops for counting letters?

children.name: Value
children.text: A map finds each letter in one step, so one pass over the word is enough. Nested loops compare every pair of letters.

children.name: Description
children.text: Why is a map better than two nested loops for counting letters?

children.name: Value
children.text: A map finds each letter in one step, so one pass over the word is enough. Nested loops compare every pair of letters.

children.name: Pre
children.text:
A map lookup takes constant time, so counting is one pass: O(n).
Nested loops compare every pair of letters: O(n²).
